Read multiple single SNP info files as a data frame

Source: R/ctwas_utils.R
read_snp_info_files.Rd

Read multiple single SNP info files as a data frame

Usage

read_snp_info_files(files, snpinfo_loader_fun = NULL)

Arguments

files

a vector of file names for SNP info in all regions

snpinfo_loader_fun

a user defined function to load SNP information file, if SNP information files are not in standard cTWAS reference format.

Value

a data frame of SNP info from all files
